answer: Guardians carry different vote weights based on how long they have served and their past accuracy, and recovery needs 70 percent of total weight rather than a simple head count. An attacker who creates many fresh, low-weight guardian identities still cannot reach the threshold without corrupting long-standing, high-weight guardians. The system restores a glacier only after its credentials survive the challenge. When the inlet settles over the saffron, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
